lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 1 fix 002: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: US-R1-002 is a doc-only fix: the last sentence of the 'Single-source outcome contract' bullet in patterns.md (line 77) stated that 'worker-report-fallback' labels the ABSENT-REPORT failure path -- which is factually inverted. The label actually appears inside the valid-report block in result.ts (lines 318-358, the PRESENT-REPORT primary path) and loop.ts:877 derives winningSrc='worker-report' precisely because that label is present. The sentence was corrected to accurately describe the label as marking the PRESENT-REPORT primary path. Runtime behavior is unchanged. All 1372 tests pass.

officialDocsValidated.summary: US-R1-002 only edits the patterns.md doc file. No external library API was exercised.
